lines: Even if it feels like you're *standing still.*
Nothing above the ground. Nothing to *show.*
And then, almost overnight, it *shoots* up.
#You might be in your *root* years right now.
The years where you learn. Where you *fail.*
Where you build things nobody *claps* for.
But it's exactly what winning looks like *early.*
#So stop comparing your chapter one to someone's chapter *twenty.*
Some days you'll take a step *back.*
One day people will call it overnight *success.*
end: Send this to someone who feels stuck.

post.title: If You Feel Slow, Watch This Before You Quit
post.caption: You might be in your root years. 🌱 Send this to someone who needs it.
post.first_comment: What are you building right now that nobody sees yet? 👇
